_comment: One source of truth for week 7's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. NEW this week: `suite` says which test run scores an item — 'checks' is `dotnet test Project.Checks` (canonical, replaced wholesale by the grader), 'tests' is `dotnet test Project.Tests` (the student's OWN suite, run as-is — the homework dictates these four fact names), and 'both' needs the name green in the two runs at once. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b); the coursework repo is cloned only for the hygiene sweep.

Check1_WeeksFourToSixStillHold.label: Weeks 4-6 still hold — Topic, no public fields, All() copies, Find and Remove behave, IListed kept by record and registry, Everything() intact

Check2_AddingGrowsTheCount.label: Your test: adding two records grows Count to 2 — written by you, green in your own suite

Check3_FindHandsBackTheRecordItHolds.label: Your test: Find hands back the very record the registry is holding — Assert.Same, not a lookalike

Check4_RemovingAStrangerSaysNo.label: Your test: removing a name nobody has returns false and removes nothing

Check5_TheSameNameCannotRegisterTwice.label: The same name cannot register twice — your test proves it AND my check agrees the guard is really in Add

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programRuns.label: The program builds and runs without crashing — even when fed nothing but Enter

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked in NEITHER repo — the .gitignore holding, in both places

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgment call)

mergedPr.label: A merge commit on main — this week's branch → pull request → merge
